Convert eligible PDFs and scanned pages into editable Word files or extracted text for publishing, translation and content reuse. Source quality, tables, columns, equations and recognition needs determine how much cleanup or manual reconstruction is required.

Recreate document layouts in an agreed editable format when the original source file is unavailable or unsuitable. Tell us whether you need working content for translation, close visual similarity to a reference PDF, or a combination of both; those are distinct production requirements.

Choose PDF-to-Word conversion and OCR when extracting or editing content is the priority. Choose document recreation when maintaining a closely comparable page layout and rebuilding editable elements is important. A single project may require both.
For structured journal article XML rather than editable Word files, review the target tag set, article metadata and delivery requirements with our XML conversion team.
Multilingual desktop publishing for LSPs and translation agencies. Discuss target-language layout, formatting, source-file preparation and delivery requirements.
Post-translation layout does not automatically include translation.

may be needed before localization DTP. Feasibility and layout similarity depend on source quality, available assets and agreed deliverables.

For layout adaptation of translated files, explore multilingual DTP. Book and journal typesetting focuses on original publisher page composition and publication proofs.
